Internal Control and Management                                                      內部監控及管理
The Board recognises its responsibility for maintaining an adequate system of        董事會了解其有責任維持一個適當的內部監

Internal control, including a defined management structure with limits of            內 部 監 控，包 括 組 織 一 個 明 確 界 定 權 限 的 管
authority, is designed to help achieve business objectives, safeguard assets         理 架 構 來 幫 助 達 成 各 商 業 目 標，保 障 資 產 不
against unauthorised use, maintain proper accounting records for the provision       會 遭 到 不 當 使 用，維 持 妥 善 賬 目 以 提 供 可 靠
of reliable financial information for internal use or for publication. The purpose   的 財 務 訊 息 供 內 部 使 用 或 對 外 公 佈。此 制 度
of such system is to provide reasonable, but not absolute, assurance against         旨 在 合 理（但 非 絕 對）保 證 無 重 大 失 實 陳 述 或
material misstatement or loss, and to manage, rather than eliminate, risks of        損 失；及 管 理（而 非 消 除）營 運 系 統 失 誤 及 本
failure in operational systems and achievement of the Group’s objectives.            集 團 未 能 達 標 的 風 險。

I. Corporate Background                                                            一、 公司基本情況
      Weichai Power Co., Ltd. (the “Company”) is a joint stock company                濰柴動力股份有限公司（以下簡稱「本公司」）
      limited by shares incorporated in Weifang, Shandong on 23 December              是一家於2002年12月23日在山東省濰坊市
      2002.                                                                           註冊成立的股份有限公司。


      The RMB ordinary A shares and overseas listed foreign H shares issued by        本公司所發行人民幣普通股A股及境外上市
      the Company were listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and The Stock            外資股H股已分別在深圳證券交易所和香港
      Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, respectively. The registered address of          聯合交易所有限公司上市。本公司註冊地址
      the Company’s headquarters is 197, Section A, Fu Shou East Street, High         位於山東省濰坊市高新技術產業開發區福壽
      Technology Industrial Development Zone, Weifang, Shandong Province.             東街197號甲。本公司所屬行業為交通運輸
      The Company operates in the transportation equipment manufacturing              設備製造業。本公司及子公司（以下統稱「本
      industry. The major scope of operations of the Company and its                  集團」）主要經營範圍為：發動機及配套產
      subsidiaries (the “Group”) covers: design, development, production, sale,       品，汽車，汽車車橋及零部件，汽車變速器
      repair, import and export of engines and auxiliary products, automobile,        及零部件以及其他汽車零部件，液壓泵、液
      automobile axle and components, gear boxes and components and other             壓馬達、液壓閥門、齒輪和齒輪傳動裝置、
      automobile components, hydraulic pumps, hydraulic motors, hydraulic             液壓元件附屬鑄件和鑄造品、內燃機、新能
      valves, gears and gear transmission devices, ancillary casting and casting      源動力總成系統及配套產品的設計、開發、
      products of hydraulic components, internal combustion engines, new              生產、銷售、維修、進出口；技術諮詢和技
      energy powertrain systems and ancillary products; technical consultation        術服務；自有房屋租賃、鋼材銷售、企業管
      and technical services; leasing of self-owned houses; sale of steel;            理服務；叉車生產、倉庫技術及供應鏈解決
      business management service; forklift trucks production, warehousing            方案服務。以上經營範圍涉及行政許可的憑
      technology and supply chain solution services. For the aforesaid scope          許可證經營。
      of operation, operating permit(s) should be held for those operations
      requiring administrative permission.


      Weichai Group Holdings Limited and Shandong Heavy Industry Group                本公司的母公司和最終控股公司分別為於中
      Co., Ltd., established in the PRC, are the parent company and ultimate          國成立的濰柴控股集團有限公司和山東重工

          Effective interest method is the method that is used in the                      實際利率法是指計算金融資產或金融
          calculation of the amortized cost of a financial asset or a financial            負債的攤餘成本以及將利息收入或利
          liability and in the allocation and recognition of the interest income           息費用分攤計入各會計期間的方法。
          or interest expense over the accounting periods.


          Effective interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts estimated             實際利率，是指將金融資產或金融負
          future cash flows through the expected life of the financial asset or            債在預計存續期的估計未來現金流
          financial liability to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset or         量，折現為該金融資產賬面餘額或該
          to the amortized cost of a financial liability. When calculating the             金融負債攤餘成本所使用的利率。在
          effective interest rate, the Group shall estimate the expected cash              確定實際利率時，在考慮金融資產或
          flows by considering all the contractual terms of the financial assets           金融負債所有合同條款（如提前還款、
          or liabilities (for example, early repayment, extension, call and                展期、看漲期權或其他類似期權等）的
          similar options) but shall not consider the expected credit losses.              基礎上估計預期現金流量，但不考慮
                                                                                           預期信用損失。


          Amortized cost of a financial asset or financial liability is the                金融資產或金融負債的攤餘成本是以
          amount at which the financial asset or financial liability is measured           該金融資產或金融負債的初始確認金
          at initial recognition minus the principal repayments, plus or minus             額扣除已償還的本金，加上或減去採
          the cumulative amortization using the effective interest method                  用實際利率法將該初始確認金額與到
          of any difference between that initial amount and the maturity                   期日金額之間的差額進行攤銷形成的
          amount and, for financial assets, adjusted for any loss allowance.               累計攤銷額，再扣除累計計提的損失
                                                                                           準備（僅適用於金融資產）。


          10.1 Classification and measurement of financial assets                          10.1 金融資產的分類與計量
                After initial recognition, the Group shall measure different                    初始確認後，本集團對不同類別

                                                                                                以公允價值計量且其變動計入其

                                                                                                量。


                If the contractual terms of the financial asset give rise on                    金融資產的合同條款規定在特定
                specified dates to cash flows that are solely payments of                       日期產生的現金流量僅為對本金

                simultaneously, a financial asset and a financial liability shall                或同時變現該金融資產和清償該

          revenue recognized when the uncertainty is resolved. In assessing            可變對價相關的不確定性消除時，累
          whether it is highly probable that there will not be a significant           計已確認的收入金額是否極可能不會
          reversal in the amount of cumulative revenue recognized when                 發生重大轉回時，同時考慮收入轉回
          the uncertainty relevant to the variable consideration is resolved,          的可能性及轉回金額的比重。本集團
          the Group also considers the possibility of reversal of income and           在每一資產負債表日，重新評估可變
          the ratio of reversed amount. On each balance sheet date, the                對價金額，包括重新評估對可變對價
          Group re-assesses the amount of variable consideration, including            的估計是否受到限制，以反映報告期

          Defined benefit obligations                                                   設定受益義務
          The Group operates defined benefit schemes for its staff in some              本集團部分境外子公司為符合條件的
          overseas subsidiaries who meet conditions. The scheme requires                員工運作若干設定受益計劃，該計劃
          that contribution be made to an independently administered fund.              要求向獨立管理的基金繳存費用。在
          Under the scheme, staff are entitled to enjoy retirement benefit              該計劃下，員工有權享受設定受益計
          provided for under defined benefit of the plans.                              劃約定的退休福利。


          The Group’s defined benefit scheme is one requiring contribution              本集團的設定受益計劃是離職後退休
          after termination of service. The scheme requires that contribution           金計劃，該計劃要求向獨立管理的基
          be made to an independently administered fund. The scheme is                  金繳存費用。該計劃以基金為法律形
          administered by an independent trustee in the legal form of a fund.           式，並由獨立受托人進行管理，其持
          The assets held under the fund is held separately with assets of the          有的資產與本集團的資產單獨分開。
          Group. The trustee is responsible for the investment strategies of            受托人負責確定該計劃的投資策略。
          the scheme.


          The trustee assesses the level of capital of the scheme. The                  受托人審核計劃的資金水平。該審核
          assessment includes asset-liabilities matching strategies and                 包括資產－負債匹配策略和投資風險
          investment risk management strategies. The trustee determines                 管理策略。受托人根據年度審核的結
          the amount to be deployed based on the result of its annual                   果決定應繳存額。
          assessment.


          The scheme is exposed to interest rate risk, risk of change of                該計劃受利率風險、退休金受益人的
          anticipated age of beneficiaries of the pension, and risks of the             預期壽命變動風險和證券市場風險的
          securities market.                                                            影響。

          Definition of credit-impaired asset                                            已發生信用減值資產的定義
          The standard adopted by the Group to determine whether a                       為確定是否發生信用減值，本集團所
          credit impairment occurs is consistent with the internal credit                採用的界定標準，與內部針對相關金
          risk management objectives of the relevant financial instrument,               融工具的信用風險管理目標保持一
          taking into account quantitative and qualitative criteria. When the            致，同時考慮定量、定性指標。本集
          Group assesses whether the credit impairment of financial assets               團評估金融資產是否發生信用減值
          occurred, the following factors are mainly considered:                         時，主要考慮以下因素：


          •     Significant financial difficulty of the issuer or the debtor;             •   發行方或債務人發生重大財務困
                                                                                              難；


          •     Debtors are in breach of contract, such as defaulting on                  •   債務人違反合同，如償付利息或
                interest or becoming overdue on interest or principal                         本金違約或逾期等；
                payments overdue;


          •     The creditor of the debtor, for economic or contractual                   •   債權人出於與債務人財務困難有
                reasons relating to the debtor’s financial difficulty, having                 關的經濟或合同考慮，給予債務
                granted to the debtor a concession that the creditor would                    人在任何其他情況下都不會做出
                not otherwise consider;                                                       的讓步；


          •     It is becoming probable that the debtor will enter bankruptcy             •   債務人很可能破產或進行其他財
